SELECT s.student_id, s.student_no, s.name, s.emergency_contact, s.emergency_phone, CASE s.gender WHEN 1 THEN '男' ELSE '女' END as gender_str, s.class_name, u.phone as user_phone, b.name as building_name, r.room_number, CASE s.status WHEN 1 THEN '在校' WHEN 2 THEN '休学' ELSE '毕业' END as status_str FROM tb_student s LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON s.student_id = u.user_id LEFT JOIN tb_building b ON s.building_id = b.building_id LEFT JOIN tb_room r ON s.room_id = r.room_id
AND s.counselor_id = #{counselorId}
AND s.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{name}, '%')
AND s.student_no LIKE CONCAT('%', #{studentNo}, '%')
AND s.class_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{className}, '%')
ORDER BY s.student_no ASC

SELECT s.student_no, s.name, s.major_name, s.class_name, s.bed_number, u.phone as user_phone FROM tb_student s LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON s.student_id = u.user_id WHERE s.room_id = #{roomId} ORDER BY s.bed_number ASC

SELECT s.name, s.student_no, CASE s.gender WHEN 1 THEN '男' ELSE '女' END as gender_str, s.major_name, s.class_name, s.bed_number, u.phone as user_phone FROM tb_student s LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON s.student_id = u.user_id WHERE s.room_id = #{roomId} AND s.student_id != #{myId} -- 排除自己 ORDER BY s.bed_number ASC
